m: tuṇḍa n. a beak, snout (of a hog &c.), trunk (of an elephant), TĀr. x; MBh. &c.
the mouth (used contemptuously), Bādar. ii, 2, 28; Śaṃk.
the point (of an arrow &c.) See ayas-, dhūs-
N. of a Rakṣas, MBh. iii, 16372
tuṇḍa cf. asthi-, kaṅka-, kāka-, kṛṣṇa-, vāyasa-, sūkṣma-; kaṭu- and tikta-tuṇḍī
a: tuṃḍaṃ [tuṃḍ-ac] 1 Mouth, face, beak, snout (of a hog); tuṃḍairātāmrakuṭilaiḥ (śukāḥ) Kāv. 2. 9. 2 The trunk of an elephant. 3 The point of an instrument. — ḍaḥ N. of Śiva.
